text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a long, narrow, structured dark coat in a black/deep forest palette, cut with squared shoulders, a high stand collar, long straight sleeves, and a below-knee hem that creates a lean vertical silhouette. The coat is worn zipped through the front with a visible silver-toned center zipper, opening slightly at the neck to reveal a pale ivory high-neck knit or turtleneck layer underneath. Its surface mixes a subtle dark checked or grid-textured body with smooth black leather-like panels: rectangular panels across the upper chest with horizontal zip-pocket details, additional smooth vertical panels and flap-like pocket sections around the hips, and larger black panels integrated toward the lower front. Under the coat, slim glossy black leather-like trousers are visible through the front opening, tapering close to the leg and stacking slightly above dark rounded-toe shoes; a burgundy-toned sock or ankle insert shows between trouser hem and shoe. The model carries a small black structured handbag in one hand, with a short handle and a dangling chain strap, reinforcing the polished dark utilitarian-luxury styling. Hair is sleek and side-parted, keeping the focus on the sharp outerwear, monochrome texture play, and controlled elongated proportions.
key_elements: high stand collar over pale ivory turtleneck
smooth black leather-like chest and lower panels
dark rounded-toe shoes with burgundy ankle detail
small black handbag with chain strap
uncertainty_notes: Body textile appears check-textured but exact weave is not certain.
Smooth panels and trousers read as leather-like from shine, but material cannot be confirmed.
